PMID 35133310 reviews pregnancy-related risks, including fetal anatomic and neurodevelopmental concerns associated with antiseizure-medication exposure. It is a review, not a medication-specific pregnancy-exposure cohort. [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35133310/)

PMID 38841362 measured drug concentrations in maternal plasma, breast milk, and infant plasma. **No.** Its population was lactating women and their infants, and it assessed breast-milk transfer and infant drug exposure. It did not directly assess fetal exposure, congenital malformations, pregnancy outcomes, or fetal neurodevelopment. Therefore, it cannot by itself establish fetal safety during pregnancy.
